title: Escher
tagline: Escher connects interactive art to blockchains. It allows observers to become participants in the performance by allowing them to contribute to the art as it happens.
description: Why connect art to the blockchain? To use all the tooling, from authentication to ticketing to payments. Access to the art can be token or auction gated. AI interprets the transaction data sent to the smart contract and forwards that to the sculpture. Input an idea or a scene, like "ocean" or "sunset" to make your custom color palette with the help of AI.
how_its_made: The LEDs are controlled by a Pixelblaze ESP32 platform. Scaffold-eth provides the framework for the blockchain code. AI interprets the transaction data sent to the smart contract and forwards that to the sculpture. Input an idea or a scene, like "ocean" or "sunset" to make your custom color palette with the help of AI.
